Delhi AQI Crosses 450 After Diwali | Air Pollution Updates From Other Cities
Delhi woke up to severe air pollution the morning after Diwali, with the AQI crossing 450 in several areas. But how bad is the pollution in other cities? Which places recorded the highest AQI, and what does the latest air quality data reveal?
How much of this pollution is linked to firecrackers? What role did weather conditions play? And how are other Indian cities dealing with worsening air quality?
Watch this report for the latest updates on Delhi's pollution crisis and the air quality situation across India.
